institutions.name: 中国共产党全国代表大会
institutions.level_label: 党的最高领导机关之一；通常每五年举行
duties: 审议中央委员会与中央纪委报告
决定党的重大问题
修改党章并选举中央机构
authority: 选举中央委员会
选举中央纪律检查委员会
limits: 大会闭会期间的经常领导工作由中央委员会及其产生的领导机构承担。
institutions.level_label_en: One of the Party's highest leading bodies; normally convened every five years
duties_en: Review reports of the Central Committee and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
Decide major Party issues
Amend the Party Constitution and elect central Party bodies
authority_en: Elect the Central Committee
Elect the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
limits_en: Between congresses, ongoing leadership is exercised by the Central Committee and the leading bodies it elects or establishes.

institutions.name: 中共中央委员会
institutions.level_label: 中央党的领导机关；每届五年
duties: 大会闭会期间领导全党工作
贯彻全国党代会决议
全会决定中央领导机构人选
authority: 全会选举政治局、政治局常委会及总书记
决定党的中央军委组成人员
limits: 中央委员是一种党内成员身份，不能直接换算成省部级等行政职务层次。
institutions.level_label_en: Central Party leading body; five-year term
duties_en: Lead the work of the entire Party between national congresses
Implement resolutions of the Party's National Congress
Decide the membership of central leading bodies at plenary sessions
authority_en: Elect the Political Bureau, its Standing Committee and the General Secretary at a plenary session
Decide the membership of the Party's Central Military Commission
limits_en: Central Committee membership is a status within the Party; it cannot be directly converted into an administrative leadership level such as provincial/ministerial level.

institutions.name: 中共中央政治局
institutions.level_label: 中央领导机构
duties: 中央全会闭会期间行使中央委员会职权
召集中央委员会全体会议
审议重大方针与工作安排
authority: 召集中央全会
同常委会领导党中央决策议事协调机构
limits: 它与常委会的关系属于党内组织制度，不能类比为国务院内的行政上下级。
institutions.level_label_en: Central Party leading body
duties_en: Exercise the Central Committee's powers between its plenary sessions
Convene plenary sessions of the Central Committee
Review major policy directions and work arrangements
authority_en: Convene Central Committee plenary sessions
Together with its Standing Committee, lead the CPC Central Committee's decision-making, deliberative and coordinating bodies
limits_en: Its relationship with the Standing Committee is governed by the Party's organizational system and should not be equated with an administrative hierarchy within the State Council.

institutions.name: 中共中央政治局常务委员会
institutions.level_label: 中央领导机构
duties: 中央全会闭会期间行使中央委员会职权
领导重大工作的决策协调
提名中央书记处成员
authority: 由中央全会选举产生
同政治局领导中央决策议事协调机构
limits: 具体决策权限和流程须看党内法规及会议决定，不能凭常委排名量化个人权力。
institutions.level_label_en: Central Party leading body
duties_en: Exercise the Central Committee's powers between its plenary sessions
Lead decision-making and coordination on major work
Nominate members of the CPC Secretariat
authority_en: Elected by a plenary session of the Central Committee
Together with the Political Bureau, lead central Party decision-making, deliberative and coordinating bodies
limits_en: Specific decision-making powers and procedures depend on Party regulations and meeting decisions; members' order of precedence cannot be used to quantify personal power.

institutions.name: 中共中央总书记
institutions.name_en: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee
institutions.level_label: 党内领导职务
duties: 召集政治局会议
召集政治局常委会会议
主持中央书记处工作
authority: 掌握党章规定的中央会议召集职责
主持中央书记处日常工作
limits: 总书记、国家主席、军委主席是不同职务；一人兼任时应分职务解释权限。
institutions.level_label_en: Party leadership position
duties_en: Convene meetings of the Political Bureau
Convene meetings of the Political Bureau Standing Committee
Preside over the work of the CPC Secretariat
authority_en: Exercise the responsibilities for convening central Party meetings specified in the Party Constitution
Preside over the day-to-day work of the CPC Secretariat
limits_en: General Secretary, President of the PRC and CMC Chairman are distinct offices. When one person holds all three, explain the powers of each office separately.

institutions.name: 全国人民代表大会
institutions.level_label: 最高国家权力机关
duties: 制定和修改基本法律及宪法
审查批准国家计划和预算
产生并监督重要国家机构
authority: 选举国家主席、国家军委主席、国家监委主任及两高负责人
依提名决定国务院总理及组成人员
limits: 法定产生、任免和监督关系，不等同于日常行政指挥。
institutions.level_label_en: Highest organ of state power
duties_en: Enact and amend basic laws and amend the Constitution
Review and approve national plans and budgets
Constitute and supervise major state bodies
authority_en: Elect the President of the PRC, the state CMC Chairman, the Director of the National Commission of Supervision, and the heads of the Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate
Decide on the Premier and other State Council members on nomination
limits_en: Statutory relationships concerning the formation of bodies, appointments, removals and supervision are different from day-to-day administrative command.

institutions.name: 全国人大常委会
institutions.level_label: 全国人大的常设机关
duties: 行使宪法规定的立法权
监督国务院、监委和两高工作
依法决定任免及批准预算调整
authority: 解释宪法与法律并监督实施
在全国人大闭会期间行使规定范围内的国家机构任免权
limits: 职权有宪法边界，并对全国人大负责和报告工作。
institutions.level_label_en: Permanent body of the National People's Congress
duties_en: Exercise the legislative powers provided by the Constitution
Supervise the work of the State Council, the National Commission of Supervision, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate
Decide appointments and removals and approve budget adjustments as prescribed by law
authority_en: Interpret the Constitution and laws and supervise their implementation
Exercise specified powers to appoint and remove state officeholders while the NPC is not in session
limits_en: Its powers are constitutionally defined, and it is responsible to and reports to the NPC.

institutions.name: 国务院
institutions.level_label: 中央人民政府；最高国家行政机关
duties: 领导全国行政工作
制定行政法规并执行法律
编制执行国家计划和预算
authority: 统一领导所属部门与地方国家行政机关
依宪法和法律规定实施行政管理、规定部门任务
limits: 坚持党的领导，对全国人大及其常委会负责并报告工作；不把人大监督线画成行政隶属线。
institutions.level_label_en: Central People's Government; highest organ of state administration
duties_en: Lead administrative work nationwide
Formulate administrative regulations and implement laws
Prepare and implement national plans and budgets
authority_en: Exercise unified leadership over its departments and local state administrative organs
Exercise administrative functions and define departmental tasks under the Constitution and laws
limits_en: It upholds Party leadership and is responsible to and reports to the NPC and its Standing Committee. An NPC supervision link should not be drawn as administrative subordination.

institutions.name: 全国政协
institutions.level_label: 统一战线组织；专门协商机构
duties: 就公共政策开展协商
通过意见建议实施民主监督
调研并提出提案和建议
authority: 组织专题协商、调研及提案工作
向党和国家机关提出政策意见
limits: 政协的协商监督不具有人大立法、预算批准或行政许可的效力。
institutions.level_label_en: United front organization; specialized consultative body
duties_en: Conduct consultations on public policy
Exercise democratic supervision through opinions and recommendations
Conduct research and submit proposals and recommendations
authority_en: Organize thematic consultations, research and proposal work
Submit policy advice to Party and state organs
limits_en: CPPCC consultation and supervision do not have the legal effect of NPC legislation, budget approval or administrative licensing.

institutions.name: 中央军事委员会（党和国家）
institutions.level_label: 党和国家军事领导机构；实行主席负责制
duties: 领导全国武装力量
确定军事战略与作战方针
领导军队组织建设和政治工作
authority: 统一指挥武装力量并发布军事命令
依规管理军队体制编制、人员及装备建设
limits: 党的军委与国家军委有不同产生程序；国防部或国家主席这一单独职务不自动等于军队指挥权。
institutions.level_label_en: Party and state military leadership bodies; chairman responsibility system
duties_en: Lead the country's armed forces
Determine military strategy and operational principles
Lead military organization building and political work
authority_en: Exercise unified command of the armed forces and issue military orders
Manage military organization, staffing, personnel and equipment development under applicable rules
limits_en: The Party CMC and the state CMC are constituted through different procedures. The Ministry of National Defense, or the office of President of the PRC alone, does not automatically carry command of the armed forces.

institutions.name: 中央纪律检查委员会
institutions.level_label: 党的最高纪律检查机关
duties: 监督党章党规执行
检查党的路线政策落实
依权限开展执纪问责
authority: 对党员和党组织依规开展纪律审查
与国家监委共用工作机构贯通执纪执法
limits: 党纪处分与政务处分、刑事判决性质不同，不能混称为定罪。
institutions.level_label_en: Highest Party discipline inspection body
duties_en: Supervise compliance with the Party Constitution and Party regulations
Inspect implementation of the Party's line and policies
Enforce discipline and pursue accountability within its remit
authority_en: Conduct disciplinary reviews of Party members and organizations under Party rules
Share working bodies with the National Commission of Supervision to connect Party discipline enforcement with law enforcement
limits_en: Party disciplinary sanctions, administrative sanctions against public officials and criminal judgments are different measures; they should not all be described as criminal convictions.

institutions.name: 国家监察委员会
institutions.level_label: 最高监察机关
duties: 监督行使公权力的公职人员
调查职务违法和职务犯罪
依法处置并开展反腐败工作
authority: 依法采取监察调查措施、作出政务处分
涉嫌职务犯罪案件依法移送检察机关审查起诉
limits: 调查、起诉、审判是不同程序；监察权的行使须受法律规定约束。
institutions.level_label_en: Highest state supervisory organ
duties_en: Supervise public officials who exercise public power
Investigate duty-related violations and crimes
Handle cases as prescribed by law and conduct anti-corruption work
authority_en: Take statutory supervisory investigation measures and impose administrative sanctions on public officials
Refer suspected duty-related crimes to procuratorial organs for review and prosecution as prescribed by law
limits_en: Investigation, prosecution and adjudication are distinct procedures. Supervisory powers must be exercised within the limits prescribed by law.

institutions.name: 最高人民法院
institutions.level_label: 最高审判机关
duties: 审理法定管辖案件
监督下级法院审判工作
统一法律在审判中的适用
authority: 就审判中具体应用法律作司法解释
依法审理上诉、抗诉等案件并核准死刑
limits: 法院上下级主要是审判监督关系，不宜写成所有事务上的普通行政领导关系。
institutions.level_label_en: Highest adjudicative organ
duties_en: Hear cases within its statutory jurisdiction
Supervise the adjudicative work of lower courts
Unify the application of law in adjudication
authority_en: Issue judicial interpretations on the specific application of law in adjudication
Hear appeals, procuratorial protests and other cases, and approve death sentences, as prescribed by law
limits_en: The relationship between higher and lower courts primarily concerns adjudicative supervision; it should not be described as ordinary administrative leadership over all matters.

institutions.name: 最高人民检察院
institutions.level_label: 最高检察机关；法律监督机关
duties: 领导各级和专门检察院工作
依法履行批捕起诉职责
监督诉讼与生效裁判执行
authority: 依法对全国性重大刑事案件审查批捕、提起公诉
依法开展抗诉及检察公益诉讼等法律监督
limits: 检察机关提出指控和监督意见，定罪量刑由法院依法审判。
institutions.level_label_en: Highest procuratorial organ; organ of legal supervision
duties_en: Lead the work of procuratorates at all levels and specialized procuratorates
Perform statutory duties to approve arrests and bring prosecutions
Supervise litigation and the enforcement of effective judgments and rulings
authority_en: Review and approve arrests and bring public prosecutions in major nationwide criminal cases as prescribed by law
Exercise legal supervision through procuratorial protests, public-interest litigation and other statutory means
limits_en: Procuratorial organs bring charges and issue supervisory opinions; courts determine guilt and sentence through adjudication under the law.

institutions.name: 中央金融委员会
institutions.level_label: 党中央决策议事协调机构
duties: 研究金融领域重大问题
统筹金融稳定和发展
协调推进并督促重大部署
authority: 审议金融重大政策
通过中央金融办组织协调落实
limits: 委员会的战略协调职责与监管部门对具体机构的许可、检查、处罚职责有别。
institutions.level_label_en: CPC Central Committee decision-making, deliberative and coordinating body
duties_en: Study major issues in the financial sector
Coordinate financial stability and development
Coordinate implementation of major decisions and oversee follow-through
authority_en: Review major financial policies
Organize and coordinate implementation through the Office of the Central Financial Commission
limits_en: The commission's strategic coordination role is distinct from regulators' powers to license, inspect and sanction specific institutions.

institutions.name: 中央金融工作委员会
institutions.level_label: 党中央派出机关
duties: 领导金融系统党的工作
指导金融系统组织建设
指导作风纪律等党的建设
authority: 承接金融系统党建领导职责
与中央金融委员会办公室合署办公
limits: 这是金融系统党的工作机关，不能当成办理金融行政许可的监管总局。
institutions.level_label_en: Agency dispatched by the CPC Central Committee
duties_en: Lead Party work in the financial system
Guide Party organization building in the financial system
Guide Party building, including conduct and discipline
authority_en: Exercise leadership responsibilities for Party building in the financial system
Share offices with the Office of the Central Financial Commission
limits_en: This is a body for Party work in the financial system; it should not be treated as a financial regulator that processes administrative licences.

institutions.name: 国家金融监督管理总局
institutions.level_label: 国务院直属机构
duties: 监管除证券业外的金融业
管理银行保险等机构准入和经营行为
统筹金融消费者权益保护
authority: 依法现场检查并查处违法违规行为
对派出机构实行垂直管理
limits: 部门职责与央行货币政策、证监会证券监管须按分工区分。
institutions.level_label_en: Institution directly under the State Council
duties_en: Regulate the financial industry except the securities sector
Manage market entry and business conduct of banks, insurers and other institutions
Coordinate protection of financial consumers' rights and interests
authority_en: Conduct on-site inspections and investigate and sanction violations as prescribed by law
Exercise vertical management over its dispatched agencies
limits_en: Its responsibilities must be distinguished from the central bank's monetary policy role and the CSRC's securities regulation role.

institutions.name: 中国证券监督管理委员会
institutions.level_label: 国务院直属机构；正部级（官网明确）
duties: 监管证券期货基金市场
监督证券发行上市交易等活动
依法监管公司及企业债券相关业务
authority: 制定监管规章规则并依法执法
通过证监局等派出机构开展辖区监管
limits: 2023年已由直属事业单位改为直属机构；不能继续使用旧机构性质。
institutions.level_label_en: Institution directly under the State Council; full ministerial level (explicitly stated on its official website)
duties_en: Regulate securities, futures and fund markets
Supervise securities issuance, listing, trading and related activities
Regulate relevant corporate and enterprise bond business as prescribed by law
authority_en: Make regulatory rules and conduct statutory enforcement
Conduct local regulatory work through securities regulatory bureaus and other dispatched agencies
limits_en: In 2023 it changed from a public institution directly under the State Council to an institution directly under the State Council; its former institutional classification should no longer be used.

institutions.name: 中国人民银行
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门；中央银行
duties: 制定执行货币和信贷政策
负责宏观审慎管理及系统性风险防范
管理货币发行、支付等中央银行事务
authority: 使用法定货币政策工具调节流动性
统一领导和管理人民银行分支机构
limits: 2023年金融控股集团日常监管等职责已划至金融监管总局；不要照抄改革前职责。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council; central bank
duties_en: Formulate and implement monetary and credit policies
Oversee macroprudential management and prevention of systemic risk
Manage currency issuance, payments and other central banking matters
authority_en: Use statutory monetary policy instruments to regulate liquidity
Exercise unified leadership and management over PBOC branches
limits_en: In 2023, routine supervision of financial holding groups and certain other responsibilities were transferred to the National Financial Regulatory Administration; pre-reform duties should not be copied without checking.

institutions.name: 中央全面深化改革委员会
institutions.name_en: Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform
institutions.level_label: 党中央决策议事协调机构
duties: 研究重大改革布局
协调跨领域改革
推动改革落实与督促检查
authority: 统筹重大改革方案的协调推进
按2023年方案统筹党和国家机构改革组织实施
limits: 重大改革方案仍须由有关党和国家机关依权限履行各自决策、立法和执行程序。
institutions.level_label_en: CPC Central Committee decision-making, deliberative and coordinating body
duties_en: Study the overall design of major reforms
Coordinate reforms across policy areas
Promote reform implementation and conduct oversight and inspections
authority_en: Coordinate and advance major reform plans
Coordinate the organization and implementation of Party and state institutional reform under the 2023 plan
limits_en: Major reform plans must still pass through the relevant Party and state bodies' respective decision-making, legislative and implementation procedures within their authority.

institutions.name: 中央外事工作委员会
institutions.level_label: 党中央决策议事协调机构
duties: 统筹外事重大工作
协调外交战略布局
督促重大外事部署落实
authority: 通过中央外办开展综合协调
统筹跨部门重大外事事项
limits: 中央外办与外交部是不同机构；后者承担广泛具体国家外交事务。
institutions.level_label_en: CPC Central Committee decision-making, deliberative and coordinating body
duties_en: Coordinate major foreign affairs work
Coordinate diplomatic strategy
Oversee implementation of major foreign affairs decisions
authority_en: Conduct overall coordination through the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission
Coordinate major foreign affairs matters across departments
limits_en: The Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are separate bodies; the ministry handles a broad range of specific state diplomatic affairs.

institutions.name: 外交部
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门
duties: 办理双边和多边外交事务
处理条约、领事保护等工作
协调地方和部门外事工作
authority: 领导驻外外交机构及驻港澳特派员公署
组织或参与有关外交谈判、对外交涉
limits: 外事领导协调机构形成战略安排，外交部在职责范围内履行外交行政工作。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council
duties_en: Handle bilateral and multilateral diplomatic affairs
Handle treaties, consular protection and related matters
Coordinate foreign affairs work by localities and departments
authority_en: Lead diplomatic missions abroad and the commissioner's offices in Hong Kong and Macao
Organize or participate in relevant diplomatic negotiations and representations
limits_en: Foreign affairs leadership and coordination bodies set strategic arrangements; the ministry performs diplomatic administrative work within its remit.

institutions.name: 财政部
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门
duties: 编制中央预决算草案
组织中央财政收支与预算执行
拟订财税政策和财务制度
authority: 审核批复中央部门预决算
组织中央财政拨款和相关监督
limits: 预算草案的编制、人大审查批准、部门执行是不同环节；财政部不自行批准全部国家预算。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council
duties_en: Prepare draft central budgets and final accounts
Organize central government revenue, expenditure and budget execution
Draft fiscal and tax policies and financial management systems
authority_en: Review and approve central departments' budgets and final accounts
Organize central fiscal disbursements and related oversight
limits_en: Drafting a budget, NPC review and approval, and departmental execution are separate stages; the ministry does not independently approve the entire national budget.

institutions.name: 地方党委（省、市、县）
institutions.level_label: 示意节点；具体层级及隶属须看当地机构
duties: 决定本地区重大方向和部署
协调本地党和国家机关工作
按干部管理权限管理和推荐干部
authority: 常委会依规集体讨论干部事项
通过法定程序推动主张转为地方制度及政令
limits: 这是多层级概括节点；省、市、县分别有对应上级党委，不能画成全部直属中央。
institutions.level_label_en: Illustrative node; actual level and reporting relationships depend on the local body
duties_en: Decide major local policy directions and work arrangements
Coordinate local Party and state bodies
Manage and recommend officials within its cadre-management authority
authority_en: Collectively discuss personnel matters in its standing committee under Party rules
Use statutory procedures to translate Party proposals into local institutions and government measures
limits_en: This node summarizes multiple levels. Provincial, city and county committees each have corresponding higher-level Party committees; they should not all be shown as reporting directly to the centre.

institutions.name: 地方人民政府（省、市、县）
institutions.level_label: 示意节点；依法分级负责
duties: 执行法律和上级行政决定
组织本地公共行政和服务
编制执行本级计划和预算
authority: 统一领导所属工作部门
依权限管理行政人员并执行本级预算
limits: 须向本级人大和上一级行政机关负责；多层级节点不表示市县直接由国务院日常管理。
institutions.level_label_en: Illustrative node; responsibilities allocated by level under law
duties_en: Implement laws and administrative decisions of higher authorities
Organize local public administration and services
Prepare and implement plans and budgets at its own level
authority_en: Exercise unified leadership over its departments
Manage administrative personnel within its authority and execute the budget at its own level
limits_en: It is responsible to the people's congress at the same level and the administrative organ at the next higher level. This multi-level node does not imply that the State Council manages cities and counties directly on a day-to-day basis.

institutions.name: 地方政府工作部门（以财政部门为例）
institutions.level_label: 同级政府工作部门；规格因层级和机构而异
duties: 承担本地专业行政事务
落实同级政府的工作部署
接受依法规定的上级业务指导或领导
authority: 在法定辖区和职权内办理行政事项
执行部门预算和业务管理任务
limits: 中央部委通常不是地方对应局的人财物直接管理者；是否垂直管理必须逐系统核实。
institutions.level_label_en: Department of the government at the same level; institutional rank varies by level and body
duties_en: Handle specialized local administrative matters
Implement work arrangements of the government at the same level
Receive professional guidance or leadership from higher-level authorities as prescribed by law
authority_en: Handle administrative matters within its statutory jurisdiction and powers
Execute departmental budgets and professional management tasks
limits_en: Central ministries usually do not directly manage the personnel, finances and assets of their local counterparts. Whether a system operates under vertical management must be checked separately.

institutions.name: 人民银行省级及地市分支机构
institutions.level_label: 人民银行派出机构
duties: 执行授权范围内的中央银行业务
开展辖区金融管理和服务
向人民银行系统报告和落实部署
authority: 接受总行统一领导管理
按授权履行货币政策、金融管理及服务职能
limits: 省级分行不等于省政府金融部门；2023年改革撤销原大区分行及县市支行设置。
institutions.level_label_en: Dispatched agencies of the PBOC
duties_en: Conduct central banking business within delegated authority
Provide financial management and services within their jurisdictions
Report within the PBOC system and implement its decisions
authority_en: Operate under the unified leadership and management of the head office
Perform monetary policy, financial management and service functions within delegated authority
limits_en: A provincial PBOC branch is not a provincial government financial department. The 2023 reform abolished the former regional branches and county/city sub-branch arrangements.

institutions.name: 国家税务总局
institutions.level_label: 国务院直属机构；正部级（官网明确）
duties: 组织税收及有关税费征管
制定税收征管规则和服务制度
管理全国税务系统
authority: 组织税收执法与监督检查
以总局为主实施与省区市党委政府双重领导
limits: 税务总局不是财政部内设机构；税收政策制定与征收管理分工也不能混同。
institutions.level_label_en: Institution directly under the State Council; full ministerial level (explicitly stated on its official website)
duties_en: Organize collection and administration of taxes and related levies
Formulate tax administration rules and service systems
Manage the national tax administration system
authority_en: Organize tax enforcement, supervision and inspections
Lead a system of dual leadership shared with provincial-level Party committees and governments, with the STA playing the primary role
limits_en: The STA is not an internal department of the Ministry of Finance. Tax policymaking and tax collection and administration also have distinct responsibilities.

institutions.name: 各地税务局
institutions.level_label: 税务系统；以总局为主的双重领导体制
duties: 征收辖区税费
提供纳税服务并落实税收政策
开展税收风险管理与执法
authority: 依法实施征管检查和相关行政处理
按税务系统分工执行收入管理任务
limits: 2018年国税地税合并后，不再用旧的国税垂管、地税地方为主模型解释现行关系。
institutions.level_label_en: Tax administration system; dual leadership with the STA playing the primary role
duties_en: Collect taxes and levies within their jurisdictions
Provide taxpayer services and implement tax policies
Conduct tax risk management and enforcement
authority_en: Conduct tax administration inspections and related administrative actions as prescribed by law
Perform revenue administration tasks under the division of responsibilities within the tax system
limits_en: Since the 2018 merger of state and local tax administrations, the old model of vertically managed state tax offices and primarily locally managed local tax offices no longer explains current relationships.

institutions.name: 商务部
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门
duties: 拟订国内外贸易与国际经济合作政策
推进商贸流通、消费市场及外商投资相关工作
牵头多双边经贸谈判及贸易救济
authority: 依权限开展出口管制许可、贸易调查等管理
承担世贸组织谈判、政策审议与争端解决相关工作
limits: 经营者集中反垄断执法已划至市场监管总局；对外援助政策、计划和资金规模方向等已划至国际发展合作署。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council
duties_en: Draft policies on domestic and foreign trade and international economic cooperation
Advance commercial distribution, consumer markets and work relating to foreign investment
Lead multilateral and bilateral economic and trade negotiations and trade remedy work
authority_en: Administer export control licensing, trade investigations and related matters within its authority
Handle work relating to WTO negotiations, policy reviews and dispute settlement
limits_en: Antitrust enforcement for business concentrations has been transferred to the State Administration for Market Regulation. Foreign aid policy, plans, funding scale and priorities, and related responsibilities have been transferred to the China International Development Cooperation Agency.

institutions.name: 国家发展和改革委员会
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门；正部级（职责文件明确）
duties: 统筹国家发展战略、规划与年度计划
监测经济运行并协调宏观政策
推进经济体制改革与投资综合管理
authority: 按规定权限审批、核准或审核重大投资项目
安排中央财政性建设资金并统筹重大项目布局
limits: 投资权限须按目录和授权划分；2023年企业债券发行审核职责已划至证监会，不可沿用旧职权。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council; full ministerial level (explicitly stated in its responsibilities document)
duties_en: Coordinate national development strategies, plans and annual programmes
Monitor economic performance and coordinate macroeconomic policies
Advance economic system reform and overall investment management
authority_en: Examine, approve or review major investment projects within prescribed powers
Allocate central fiscal construction funds and coordinate the layout of major projects
limits_en: Investment powers depend on applicable catalogues and delegations. Review of enterprise bond issuance was transferred to the CSRC in 2023; the former powers should not be carried forward.

institutions.name: 工业和信息化部
institutions.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门
duties: 制定实施工业与信息通信业政策规划
推进技术改造、高新技术产业化和中小企业发展
管理信息通信行业及无线电资源
authority: 按职责实施信息通信业准入和行业监管
制定行业规范标准并管理无线电频谱资源
limits: 行业管理不等于直接指挥企业经营；网络信息安全综合协调等与网信部门有职责分工。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council
duties_en: Formulate and implement industrial and information and communications policies and plans
Advance technological upgrading, commercialization of high technology and the development of small and medium-sized enterprises
Manage the information and communications industry and radio resources
authority_en: Administer market entry and regulation in information and communications within its remit
Set industry norms and standards and manage radio spectrum resources
limits_en: Industry administration does not mean directly commanding businesses' operations. Responsibilities such as overall coordination of cybersecurity are divided with cyberspace authorities.

institutions.name: 国家数据局
institutions.level_label: 国家发展改革委管理的国家局；副部级（官网明确）
duties: 统筹数字中国、数字经济和数字社会建设
推进数据基础制度与数据要素市场建设
促进数据资源共享利用及数字基础设施建设
authority: 牵头拟订数据要素相关法规草案和标准规范
协调公共数据开发利用、跨部门资源互通及相关数字化工作
limits: 在职责范围内承担相应数据安全工作；不能概括成主管一切数据、网信安全或数字政府事务的机关。
institutions.level_label_en: National administration managed by the NDRC; vice-ministerial level (explicitly stated on its official website)
duties_en: Coordinate development of Digital China, the digital economy and digital society
Advance foundational data institutions and the market for data as a factor of production
Promote data sharing and use and the development of digital infrastructure
authority_en: Lead drafting of proposed regulations, standards and norms concerning data as a factor of production
Coordinate public data development and use, cross-departmental resource connectivity and related digitalization work
limits_en: It carries out relevant data security work within its remit; it should not be described as the authority over all data, cybersecurity or digital government matters.

institutions.name: 国务院国有资产监督管理委员会
institutions.name_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council
institutions.level_label: 国务院直属特设机构；正部级（官网明确）
duties: 依授权监管所监管中央企业国有资产
推动国企改革、重组和公司治理
考核国有资本保值增值及企业经营业绩
authority: 通过法定程序管理考核所监管企业负责人并实施奖惩
组织所监管企业上交国有资本收益并履行相关预算职责
limits: 主要履行出资人职责；监管范围不含金融类中央企业，也不是全国所有国企的直接经营管理者。
institutions.level_label_en: Special institution directly under the State Council; full ministerial level (explicitly stated on its official website)
duties_en: Supervise state-owned assets of the central enterprises within its authorized remit
Advance state-owned enterprise reform, restructuring and corporate governance
Assess preservation and growth of state-owned capital and enterprise operating performance
authority_en: Manage and assess leaders of enterprises under its supervision, and reward or sanction them, through statutory procedures
Organize remittance of state-owned capital income by supervised enterprises and perform related budget duties
limits_en: It primarily performs the state's ownership responsibilities. Its remit excludes financial central enterprises, and it does not directly manage the operations of all state-owned enterprises nationwide.

institutions.name: 中央财经委员会
institutions.name_en: Central Commission for Financial and Economic Affairs
institutions.level_label: 党中央决策议事协调机构
duties: 研究经济社会发展重大问题
制定经济工作重大方针
统筹协调重大财经部署落实
authority: 通过委员会会议审议重大经济战略政策
由中央财经委员会办公室承担办事机构工作
limits: 中央财经委员会与2023年新设中央金融委员会是不同机构；不能因中文都含“财金”而合并。
institutions.level_label_en: CPC Central Committee decision-making, deliberative and coordinating body
duties_en: Study major economic and social development issues
Set major principles for economic work
Coordinate implementation of major financial and economic decisions
authority_en: Review major economic strategies and policies at commission meetings
Have its administrative work undertaken by the Office of the Central Commission for Financial and Economic Affairs
limits_en: This commission and the Central Financial Commission established in 2023 are separate bodies; similarity in their Chinese names does not make them one institution.

institutions.name: 中央金融委员会办公室
institutions.name_en: Office of the Central Financial Commission
institutions.level_label: 党中央机构序列中的中央金融委办事机构
duties: 承担中央金融委员会办事机构工作
承接原国务院金融稳定发展委员会办公室职责
与中央金融工作委员会合署运行
authority: 作为金融委员会的办事机构支撑其履职
依2023年改革方案接收原国务院金融委办公室职责
limits: 公开改革方案未完整展开其全部具体权限；不能据“办公室”职务推断其拥有监管总局全部许可处罚权。
institutions.level_label_en: Administrative office of the Central Financial Commission within the CPC Central Committee's institutional structure
duties_en: Serve as the administrative office of the Central Financial Commission
Take over the responsibilities of the former Office of the State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee
Operate jointly with the Central Financial Work Commission
authority_en: Support the Central Financial Commission in carrying out its functions as its administrative office
Receive the former State Council financial committee office's responsibilities under the 2023 reform plan
limits_en: The published reform plan does not set out all its specific powers. Holding an office position here does not imply possession of all the NFRA's licensing and sanctioning powers.

institutions.name: 中央财经委员会办公室
institutions.name_en: Office of the Central Commission for Financial and Economic Affairs
institutions.level_label: 中央财经委员会办事机构
duties: 承担中央财经委员会办事机构工作
服务重大财经工作的研究协调
辅助委员会推动相关部署落实
authority: 作为中央财经委员会办事机构履行相关工作
服务委员会对经济工作重大方针的研究审议
limits: 与中央金融委员会办公室是不同办事机构；公开改革方案未完整列出全部具体职权，不额外推定行政审批权。
institutions.level_label_en: Administrative office of the Central Commission for Financial and Economic Affairs
duties_en: Serve as the administrative office of the Central Commission for Financial and Economic Affairs
Support research and coordination on major financial and economic matters
Assist the commission in advancing implementation of relevant decisions
authority_en: Perform work as the commission's administrative office
Support the commission's study and review of major principles for economic work
limits_en: It is separate from the Office of the Central Financial Commission. The published reform plan does not list all its specific powers; administrative approval powers should not be inferred.

institutions.name: 中华人民共和国主席、副主席
institutions.level_label: 国家领导职务
duties: 根据全国人大及其常委会决定公布法律、履行有关任免等职权；代表中华人民共和国进行国事活动、接受外国使节；副主席协助主席工作，可受委托代行部分职权。
limits: 国家主席不是国务院总理；两者职责与产生程序分别规定。
institutions.level_label_en: State leadership positions
duties_en: Promulgate laws and exercise relevant appointment, removal and other powers pursuant to decisions of the NPC and its Standing Committee; represent the PRC in state affairs and receive foreign diplomatic representatives. The Vice President assists the President and may exercise delegated presidential functions.
limits_en: The President of the PRC is distinct from the Premier of the State Council; their duties and selection procedures are separately prescribed.

institutions.name: 中共中央书记处
institutions.level_label: 中央领导机构的办事机构
duties: 在政治局及其常委会领导下，负责日常工作。
limits: 按党章理解职责，不把书记处书记身份直接换算为部委任职。
institutions.level_label_en: Working body of the central Party leadership
duties_en: Handle day-to-day work under the leadership of the Political Bureau and its Standing Committee.
limits_en: Understand its responsibilities through the Party Constitution; being a secretary of the Secretariat does not directly equate to holding a ministerial office.

institutions.name: 中共中央组织部
institutions.level_label: 党中央职能部门
duties: 干部、组织与人才工作。
limits: 干部选任的党内程序与国家机关法定任命程序需要分别看。
institutions.level_label_en: Functional department of the CPC Central Committee
duties_en: Cadre, organizational and talent work.
limits_en: Party procedures for selecting and appointing officials and statutory appointment procedures for state organs must be considered separately.

institutions.name: 中共中央宣传部
institutions.level_label: 党中央职能部门
duties: 宣传思想文化工作。
limits: 具体管理权限须结合机构职责和现行规则。
institutions.level_label_en: Functional department of the CPC Central Committee
duties_en: Publicity, ideological and cultural work.
limits_en: Specific management powers must be read in conjunction with institutional responsibilities and current rules.

institutions.name: 中共中央统一战线工作部
institutions.level_label: 党中央职能部门
duties: 统一战线工作。
limits: 不是全国政协；机构职能与协商平台有所区别。
institutions.level_label_en: Functional department of the CPC Central Committee
duties_en: United front work.
limits_en: It is separate from the CPPCC National Committee; a Party department's functions differ from those of a consultative platform.

institutions.name: 中共中央办公厅
institutions.level_label: 党中央综合部门（办公厅）
duties: 推动党中央决策部署落实，协调有关方面工作，承担中央运行保障事务。
limits: 办公厅主任的个人兼任职务不改变办公厅的机构属性。
institutions.level_label_en: General department of the CPC Central Committee (General Office)
duties_en: Advance implementation of CPC Central Committee decisions, coordinate relevant bodies and provide operational support for the central Party leadership.
limits_en: Other posts concurrently held by the office's director do not change the General Office's institutional character.

institutions.name: 中共中央政法委员会
institutions.level_label: 党中央职能部门
duties: 统筹政法工作。
limits: 审判与检察的法定职责分别由人民法院和人民检察院承担。
institutions.level_label_en: Functional department of the CPC Central Committee
duties_en: Coordinate political and legal affairs work.
limits_en: Statutory adjudicative and procuratorial responsibilities are respectively exercised by people's courts and people's procuratorates.

institutions.name: 中央和国家机关工作委员会
institutions.level_label: 党中央派出机关
duties: 中央和国家机关党的工作。
limits: 党务职责不等同于替代各机关行政职责。
institutions.level_label_en: Agency dispatched by the CPC Central Committee
duties_en: Party work in central Party and state organs.
limits_en: Party work responsibilities do not replace the administrative responsibilities of the respective organs.

institutions.name: 公安部
institutions.level_label: 国务院组成部门
duties: 全国公安工作。
limits: 公安、检察和审判承担不同的法定职责。
institutions.level_label_en: Constituent department of the State Council
duties_en: Public security work nationwide.
limits_en: Public security, procuratorial and adjudicative organs perform distinct statutory duties.

institutions.name: 中央外事工作委员会办公室
institutions.name_en: Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission
institutions.level_label: 中央外事工作委员会的办事机构
duties: 负责中央外事工作委员会的日常工作。
limits: 办公室与委员会本体是不同机构；办公室主任不等于委员会主任。
institutions.level_label_en: Administrative office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission
duties_en: Handle the day-to-day work of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission.
limits_en: The office and the commission itself are separate bodies; the office director is not the commission's director.

institutions.name: 中华人民共和国国际贸易谈判代表
institutions.name_en: International Trade Representative of the PRC
institutions.level_label: 正部长级岗位；并非据此确认新设独立机构
duties: 2026年9月20日国务院公告任命李成钢担任此职务。
limits: 公告没有说明机构挂靠或权限调整，不能从新职衔推导出独立部门或个人级别晋升。
institutions.level_label_en: Full ministerial-level position; this does not establish that a new independent institution has been created
duties_en: A State Council announcement dated September 20, 2026 appointed Li Chenggang to this position.
limits_en: The announcement does not specify the position's institutional affiliation or any changes in its powers. An independent department or promotion in personal rank cannot be inferred from the new title.

institutions.name: 商业银行（行业示意）
institutions.level_label_en: Regulated financial institutions; no shared administrative rank
duties_en: Provide banking services within their individual licences and governance arrangements.
limits_en: Regulation and monetary-policy transmission do not imply ownership or administrative subordination to the central bank. This node represents a sector, not one agency.
institutions.level_label_zh: 受监管的金融机构；整个行业没有统一行政级别
duties_zh: 在各自牌照和治理安排下提供银行服务。
limits_zh: 金融监管和货币政策传导，并不表示央行持有银行股权或与银行构成行政隶属关系。此节点代表一个行业。

institutions.name: 中共上海市委
institutions.level_label: 上海市级党委
institutions.level_label_en: Shanghai municipal Party committee
limits: 本节点区分上海市委与上海市政府；个人职务、时间与来源单独记录。
limits_en: The Shanghai Party committee and municipal government are distinct institutions; positions, dates and sources are recorded separately.

institutions.name: 上海市人民政府
institutions.level_label: 直辖市人民政府
institutions.level_label_en: Government of a municipality directly under the central government
limits: 这是具体地方政府节点，不把上海市委书记与上海市长合并为同一职务。
limits_en: A specific local government institution; the Party secretary and mayor are separate positions.

institutions.name: 中国共产党山东省委员会
institutions.level_label: 省级党委；机构层次与个人级别分别看
duties: 决定本地区重大方向和部署
协调本地党和国家机关工作
按干部管理权限管理和推荐干部
authority: 常委会依规集体讨论干部事项
通过法定程序推动主张转为地方制度及政令
limits: 本节点只表示山东省一级党委，不表示各市县直属党中央；党内领导、人大法定程序和政府行政职责分别看。
institutions.level_label_en: Provincial Party committee; institutional level is distinct from personal rank
duties_en: Decide major local policy directions and work arrangements
Coordinate local Party and state bodies
Manage and recommend officials within its cadre-management authority
authority_en: Collectively discuss personnel matters in its standing committee under Party rules
Use statutory procedures to translate Party proposals into local institutions and government measures
limits_en: This node represents only the provincial Party committee in Shandong. It does not place every city and county directly under the CPC Central Committee. Party leadership, statutory congress procedures and government administration remain distinct.
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 山东省的实际省级节点。在党中央领导下开展本省党的工作；省委与省政府为不同机构；parent_id仅作归组，不替代党代会选举和党内领导程序。

institutions.name: 山东省人民政府
institutions.level_label: 省级人民政府；机构层次与个人级别分别看
duties: 执行法律和上级行政决定
组织本地公共行政和服务
编制执行本级计划和预算
authority: 统一领导所属工作部门
依权限管理行政人员并执行本级预算
limits: 本节点只表示山东省一级政府；省、市、县分级负责，人大监督不等同于一般行政隶属。
institutions.level_label_en: Provincial people’s government; institutional level is distinct from personal rank
duties_en: Implement laws and administrative decisions of higher authorities
Organize local public administration and services
Prepare and implement plans and budgets at its own level
authority_en: Exercise unified leadership over its departments
Manage administrative personnel within its authority and execute the budget at its own level
limits_en: This node represents only Shandong’s provincial government. Provincial, city and county responsibilities remain distinct; people’s congress supervision is not ordinary administrative subordination.
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 山东省的实际省级节点。在国务院统一领导下依法管理本省行政工作，对本级人大及其常委会和上一级国家行政机关负责；省政府与省委为不同机构。

institutions.name: 中国共产党济南市委员会
institutions.level_label: 副省级城市的市级党委；个人级别另核
duties: 讨论决定本市重大事项与工作部署
按党内规定统筹本地区工作、管理和推荐干部
authority: 讨论决定本市重大事项与工作部署
limits: 党内领导与政府行政、人大法定程序分别表示。
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 副省级城市是城市/机构规格描述，不是本包对每名任职者个人行政级别的认证。parent_id仅用于浏览归组，不替代选举、党内领导或法定行政关系。

institutions.name: 济南市人民政府
institutions.level_label: 副省级城市的市级人民政府；个人级别另核
duties: 依法管理本市行政工作
执行本级人大及其常委会决议和上级行政机关决定
authority: 依法管理本市行政工作
limits: 市政府与市委是不同机构；市长不因姓名出现在市委名单而把政府履历并入市委。
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 副省级城市是城市/机构规格描述，不是本包对每名任职者个人行政级别的认证。parent_id仅用于浏览归组，不替代选举、党内领导或法定行政关系。

institutions.name: 济南市人民代表大会常务委员会
institutions.name_en: Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal People’s Congress
institutions.level_label: 副省级城市的市级人大常委会；个人级别另核
duties: 在本级人民代表大会闭会期间依法行使职权
依法监督本级政府、监察委员会、法院和检察院，办理法定任免事项
authority: 在本级人民代表大会闭会期间依法行使职权
limits: 本节点为常务委员会；不等于市人民代表大会全体会议，也不是上级人大常委会的行政下属。
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 副省级城市是城市/机构规格描述，不是本包对每名任职者个人行政级别的认证。parent_id仅用于浏览归组，不替代选举、党内领导或法定行政关系。

institutions.name: 中国人民政治协商会议济南市委员会
institutions.level_label: 副省级城市的市级政协组织；个人级别另核
duties: 开展政治协商、民主监督和参政议政
围绕地方公共事务提出提案、意见和建议
authority: 开展政治协商、民主监督和参政议政
limits: 政协不行使国家权力机关或行政机关的法定行政职权；不把省政协到市政协画作行政命令链。
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 副省级城市是城市/机构规格描述，不是本包对每名任职者个人行政级别的认证。parent_id仅用于浏览归组，不替代选举、党内领导或法定行政关系。

institutions.name: 中国共产党青岛市委员会
institutions.level_label: 副省级城市的市级党委；个人级别另核
duties: 讨论决定本市重大事项与工作部署
按党内规定统筹本地区工作、管理和推荐干部
authority: 讨论决定本市重大事项与工作部署
limits: 党内领导与政府行政、人大法定程序分别表示。
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 副省级城市是城市/机构规格描述，不是本包对每名任职者个人行政级别的认证。parent_id仅用于浏览归组，不替代选举、党内领导或法定行政关系。

institutions.name: 青岛市人民政府
institutions.level_label: 副省级城市的市级人民政府；个人级别另核
duties: 依法管理本市行政工作
执行本级人大及其常委会决议和上级行政机关决定
authority: 依法管理本市行政工作
limits: 市政府与市委是不同机构；市长不因姓名出现在市委名单而把政府履历并入市委。
institutions.hierarchy_annotation: 副省级城市是城市/机构规格描述，不是本包对每名任职者个人行政级别的认证。parent_id仅用于浏览归组，不替代选举、党内领导或法定行政关系。

institutions.name: 青岛市人民代表大会常务委员会
institutions.name_en: Standing Committee of the Qingdao Municipal People’s Congress

sources.title: 全市高质量招商引资指挥部会议召开
sources.evidence_summary: 8月4日下午，全市高质量招商引资指挥部会议召开。市委书记曾赞荣出席会议并讲话，市委副书记、市长任刚主持，市人大常委会主任梅建华，市政协主席孟庆斌，市委副书记、宣传部部长张惠出席。

sources.title: 中共济南市委十二届一次全会公报

sources.title: 孟庆斌当选青岛市政协主席
sources.evidence_summary: 政协第十四届青岛市委员会第三次会议1月31日选举孟庆斌为市政协主席。

sources.title: 刘强同志任山东省委副书记

events.title: 任命与中美元首会晤撮合的因果解释未证实
events.description: 9月20日的新任命已核实，但任命公告没有说明该调整是为了撮合习近平与特朗普会晤。可比较新旧职衔与公开磋商时间线，不能把时间相近直接写成任命动机或撮合因果。
events.title_en: Claim that the appointment was intended to broker a China–US leaders' meeting remains unverified
events.description_en: The new appointment on September 20 has been verified, but the appointment notice does not say the change was intended to arrange a meeting between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump. The old and new titles can be compared with the public consultation timeline; proximity in time cannot by itself establish the motive for the appointment or a causal role in arranging a meeting.

events.title: 李成钢获任中华人民共和国国际贸易谈判代表（正部长级）
events.description: 9月20日确有新任命：正式职衔是中华人民共和国国际贸易谈判代表（正部长级），此前为商务部国际贸易谈判代表（正部长级）兼副部长。新旧个人级别均为正部长级；不是商务部部长任命。公告同时载明凌激兼任中华人民共和国国际贸易谈判副代表，但没有说明机构是否独立、职权如何变化，也未免去李成钢副部长职务。
events.title_en: Li Chenggang appointed International Trade Representative of the PRC at full ministerial level
events.description_en: A new appointment did take place on September 20. The formal title is International Trade Representative of the PRC, at full ministerial level; previously, it was International Trade Representative of the Ministry of Commerce, at full ministerial level, and Vice Minister. His personal rank is full ministerial level under both titles; this is not an appointment as Minister of Commerce. The notice also names Ling Ji concurrently as Deputy International Trade Representative of the PRC. It does not explain whether the institution is independent or how its powers may have changed, and it does not remove Li Chenggang from his vice-ministerial post.

events.title: 程福波获任国务院国资委主任
events.description: 人社部公布国务院任命程福波为国资委主任；现任履历和9月活动均与此一致。原主任张玉卓免职已在6月5日任免公告中公布。
events.title_en: Cheng Fubo appointed Chairman of the State Council's SASAC
events.description_en: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security announced that the State Council had appointed Cheng Fubo as Chairman of SASAC. His current biography and September activities are consistent with this appointment. The removal of former Chairman Zhang Yuzhuo had already been announced in the June 5 appointments and removals notice.

events.title: 程福波任国务院国资委党委书记
events.description: 中央决定任命程福波为国务院国资委党委书记。
events.title_en: Cheng Fubo becomes Party Committee Secretary of the State Council's SASAC
events.description_en: The CPC Central Committee decided to appoint Cheng Fubo as Party Committee Secretary of the State Council's SASAC.

events.title: 丁向群获任金融监管总局局长
events.description: 人社部发布国务院任免信息，任命丁向群为国家金融监督管理总局局长；总局6月9日活动进一步确认党委书记兼局长身份。
events.title_en: Ding Xiangqun appointed head of the NFRA
events.description_en: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security published State Council appointment and removal information naming Ding Xiangqun as head of the National Financial Regulatory Administration. An NFRA activity report dated June 9 further confirmed that she held both the Party Committee Secretary and agency head positions.

events.title: 丁向群任金融监管总局党委书记
events.description: 中央决定任命丁向群为国家金融监督管理总局党委书记。
events.title_en: Ding Xiangqun becomes Party Committee Secretary of the NFRA
events.description_en: The CPC Central Committee decided to appoint Ding Xiangqun as Party Committee Secretary of the National Financial Regulatory Administration.

events.title: 李乐成获任工业和信息化部部长
events.description: 全国人大常委会决定、国家主席令任命李乐成为工信部部长，免去金壮龙的部长职务；李乐成此前于2月28日已任党组书记。
events.title_en: Li Lecheng appointed Minister of Industry and Information Technology
events.description_en: Following a decision of the NPC Standing Committee, a presidential order appointed Li Lecheng as Minister of Industry and Information Technology and removed Jin Zhuanglong from that ministerial post. Li Lecheng had already become Secretary of the ministry's Leading Party Members Group on February 28.

events.title: 李成钢获任国际贸易谈判代表（正部长级）兼副部长
events.description: 国务院公报将任命记于2025年3月31日；人社部于4月16日公布，同时免去王受文的国际贸易谈判代表、副部长职务。这不是商务部部长任命。
events.title_en: Li Chenggang appointed International Trade Representative at full ministerial level and Vice Minister
events.description_en: The State Council Gazette dates the appointment to March 31, 2025. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security announced it on April 16, also removing Wang Shouwen from the International Trade Representative and Vice Minister positions. This was not an appointment as Minister of Commerce.

events.title: 郭飞任济宁市代理市长
events.description: 济宁市人大常委会8月9日决定任命副市长并决定代理市长；公告8月10日发布。代理阶段与后续正式当选分开保存。

events.title: 郭飞当选济宁市市长
events.description: 济宁市人大会议8月24日选举；报道发布于8月25日。

events.title: 公布张海波任威海市委书记
events.description: 省委决定张海波接任，闫剑波不再担任威海市委书记、常委、委员。此日期为公开宣布日，公告没有给出内部决定日。

events.title: 孙开连当选济南市政协主席
events.description: 济南市政协十五届五次会议选举孙开连为市政协主席。

events.title: 公布刘强任山东省委副书记
events.description: 任命于7月14日公开，公告称日前批准，未给出具体内部决定日。其济南市委书记兼任由后续官方活动另外核实。

events.title: 朱忠明任上海市代理市长，龚正辞去市长
events.description: 上海市人大常委会9月4日接受龚正辞去市长职务的请求，任命朱忠明为副市长并决定为代理市长。此记录不据市长辞任推定其他党内职务或退休状态。

events.title: 闫剑波获任山东省副省长
events.description: 山东省人大常委会决定任命闫剑波为副省长。他的威海市委职务至7月另有免任公告，两套机构的时间交叠分别保留。

guides.title: 先读连线，再看位置
guides.body: 选举产生、党内领导、行政领导、依法监督、业务指导、合署办公是不同关系。节点位置与 parent_id 只便于归组，不能据此把人大、国务院、政协和司法机关串成一条行政命令链。地方节点概括多个层级，并不表示每个市县直接向中央报事。
guides.title_en: Read the links before the layout
guides.body_en: Election, Party leadership, administrative leadership, statutory supervision, professional guidance and shared offices are distinct relationships. Node positions and parent_id only group items for display; they must not be used to place the NPC, State Council, CPPCC and judicial organs in a single administrative chain of command. Local nodes summarize multiple levels and do not mean that every city and county reports directly to the centre.

guides.title: 党内决策与国家程序
guides.body: 党的领导通过重大方向、组织干部和决策协调等机制运行；立法、行政任命、预算批准、行政执法仍有各自法定主体与程序。看一项政策时分别追踪谁提出、谁审议、谁依法作决定、谁执行以及谁监督。
guides.body_en: Party leadership operates through major policy direction, organizational and cadre work, and decision coordination. Legislation, administrative appointments, budget approval and administrative enforcement each retain their own statutory decision-makers and procedures. To understand a policy, trace separately who proposes it, who reviews it, who makes the legal decision, who implements it and who supervises it.

guides.title: 正国到副厅：六个常见简称
guides.body: 正式领导职务层次依次为国家级正职（正国）、国家级副职（副国）、省部级正职（正部）、省部级副职（副部）、厅局级正职（正厅）、厅局级副职（副厅）；之后还有县处级和乡科级。领导职务层次、机构规格、职级与数字级别是不同概念，不能互相直接替换。
guides.title_en: Six common leadership ranks, from national to deputy bureau level
guides.body_en: The formal leadership hierarchy runs from national-level principal (zhengguo), national-level deputy (fuguo), provincial/ministerial-level principal (zhengbu), provincial/ministerial-level deputy (fubu), department/bureau-level principal (zhengting), to department/bureau-level deputy (futing). County/division and township/section levels follow. Leadership position level, institutional rank, civil-service rank and numerical grade are distinct concepts and cannot be used interchangeably.

guides.title: 中央委员不等于某一行政级别
guides.body: 中央委员和候补委员说明党内成员身份；政治局、政府、军队等具体职务另有职责和规格。识别个人地位时同时查看现任职务、兼任职务、职责分工以及明确公布的级别。不因姓名出现在中央委员名单就自动标注正部或副国。
guides.title_en: Central Committee membership is not an administrative rank
guides.body_en: Full and alternate Central Committee membership indicate status within the Party. Specific posts in the Political Bureau, government, armed forces and other bodies have their own responsibilities and ranks. Assess a person's position by checking current posts, concurrent posts, assigned responsibilities and any explicitly published rank. A name appearing on a Central Committee list does not automatically justify a full ministerial-level or deputy national-level designation.

guides.title: 用权限看影响力
guides.body: 不设置单一权力分数。逐项看议题召集和审议权限、干部推荐与任免权限、预算编制批准执行权限、许可执法权限，以及所辖机构和人员管理权限。例如中央金融委员会协调重大金融政策，监管总局依法检查金融机构，两者不是同一种权力。
guides.body_en: There is no single power score. Examine separately the powers to convene and review policy matters; recommend, appoint and remove officials; prepare, approve and execute budgets; issue licences and enforce rules; and manage subordinate institutions and personnel. For example, the Central Financial Commission coordinates major financial policy, while the NFRA inspects financial institutions under the law. These are different kinds of power.

guides.title: 干部任用至少看两个环节
guides.body: 党管干部制度中，党委及组织部门按权限开展推荐、考察、管理等工作；国家机关职位还须走相应选举、决定任命或任免程序。同一新闻中的党委决定、代省长任命和正式当选省长，表示不同环节，不能合并成同一个日期。
guides.title_en: Appointments involve at least two stages
guides.body_en: Under the Party's cadre-management system, Party committees and organization departments recommend, assess and manage officials within their authority. State offices also require the relevant election, appointment decision, or appointment and removal procedures. A Party committee decision, an appointment as acting governor and formal election as governor reported in the same story are separate stages and must not be collapsed into a single date.

guides.title: 条块：专业系统与属地统筹
guides.body: 块是一个行政区域的党委和政府，统筹地区工作；条是跨地区的专业主管系统。一般地方政府工作部门受同级政府统一领导，也依法律或行政法规受上级主管部门的业务指导或者领导。因此中央部委与地方对应局的关系不能一概写作垂直领导，人事、经费、执法权限应逐系统核对。
guides.title_en: Tiao and kuai: professional systems and territorial coordination
guides.body_en: Kuai refers to the Party committee and government of an administrative area, which coordinate work within that territory. Tiao refers to a specialized administrative system that spans areas. Ordinary local government departments are under the unified leadership of the government at the same level and, under laws or administrative regulations, receive professional guidance or leadership from the corresponding higher-level authority. Central ministries and their local counterparts therefore cannot all be described as a vertical chain of command; personnel, funding and enforcement powers must be checked system by system.

guides.title: 央行分支与税务局并不相同
guides.body: 人民银行分支机构是总行派出机构，法律规定由总行统一领导管理。税务系统在2018年国税地税合并后，实行以税务总局为主、与省区市党委和政府双重领导。两者都不同于普通地方政府工作部门；双重领导也不意味着双方各占一半权限。
guides.title_en: Central bank branches and tax offices follow different systems
guides.body_en: PBOC branches are dispatched agencies of the head office and, by law, operate under its unified leadership and management. Since state and local tax administrations merged in 2018, the tax system has operated under dual leadership by the STA and provincial-level Party committees and governments, with the STA playing the primary role. Both differ from ordinary local government departments. Dual leadership does not imply that each side holds half the powers.

guides.title: 三个名称接近，职责不同
guides.body: 中央财经委员会统筹相关重大财经工作；2023年新设的中央金融委员会专门研究统筹金融稳定发展；中央金融工作委员会负责金融系统党的工作。人民银行偏重货币政策和宏观审慎，金融监管总局监管除证券业之外的金融业，证监会监管证券期货基金等资本市场活动。具体交叉业务还须查现行职责文件。
guides.body_en: The Central Commission for Financial and Economic Affairs coordinates relevant major financial and economic work. The Central Financial Commission, established in 2023, focuses on studying and coordinating financial stability and development. The Central Financial Work Commission is responsible for Party work in the financial system. The PBOC focuses on monetary policy and macroprudential management; the NFRA regulates the financial industry except the securities sector; and the CSRC regulates capital-market activities such as securities, futures and funds. Specific areas of overlap require checking current responsibilities documents.

guides.title: 中央外办与外交部
guides.body: 中央外事工作委员会负责重大外事工作的战略和协调，中央外办是其办事机构。外交部是国务院组成部门，处理外交交涉、条约、领事保护并领导驻外外交机构。一个人兼任相关职务，不会使这些机构在法律和组织上合并。
guides.title_en: The central foreign affairs office and the foreign ministry
guides.body_en: The Central Foreign Affairs Commission handles strategy and coordination for major foreign affairs work; its office is its administrative body. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is a constituent department of the State Council that handles diplomatic representations, treaties and consular protection and leads diplomatic missions abroad. One person holding posts in several of these bodies does not merge them legally or organizationally.

guides.title: 合署办公不等于职责消失
guides.body: 中央纪委和国家监委共用工作机构，分别依据党内法规和国家法律履行纪检与监察职责。党的军委与国家军委在党和国家制度中有两个地位，产生程序分别适用党章和宪法。图中合并展示军委便于阅读，不省略两种法定身份。
guides.body_en: The CCDI and the National Commission of Supervision share working bodies but perform Party discipline inspection and state supervision functions under Party regulations and state law respectively. The Party CMC and state CMC occupy distinct positions in the Party and state systems; their respective formation procedures follow the Party Constitution and the state Constitution. The chart combines the CMCs for readability while retaining both institutional identities.

guides.title: 把预算看成一条程序链
guides.body: 财政部门组织编制预算草案，政府提出，人大按权限审查批准，政府及部门组织执行，人大及其常委会监督。预算批准、资金拨付和税费征收不是同一权限。研究实际资源配置可继续查部门预算、决算和转移支付，而不能只看官员职务名称。
guides.title_en: Follow the budget through its procedural stages
guides.body_en: Finance departments organize preparation of the draft budget; the government submits it; the people's congress reviews and approves it within its powers; the government and its departments execute it; and the people's congress and its standing committee supervise it. Budget approval, fund disbursement and collection of taxes and levies are different powers. To study actual resource allocation, consult departmental budgets, final accounts and transfers rather than relying only on officials' job titles.

guides.title: 资料核对与更新
guides.body: 网页展示最近一次发布时已经核对的资料。官方新公告可以从原始来源阅读；人物、职务和履历经过复核后，再发布新的数据版本。任命生效日、公告日和资料核对日分别保存。

guides.title: 人物之间的连线，能说明什么？
guides.body:
同机构、同地、同场，是三类不同的事实。两人的任职时间在同一机构有确定交集，才标为“确定同期”；同一年交接但月份未知，或者只在交接日相接，标为“时间待核”。只知道在同一省、市工作过，不需要两人在同一时期，也不等于同事。

“公开活动交集”依据具名报道，详情保留活动日期和原文链接。它不说明私人交情、派系或任用原因。省委与省政府、纪委与监委分别记录，不能因为合署或兼任就视为同一份任职。

地方页可以分别看现任在此、曾任在此；省级地区还能切换本级机构与下辖城市。每个档案都是已核实片段，未列出不等于不存在。

guides.title: 把履历网当作研究资料
guides.body:
UC San Diego 的 China Data Lab 提供 CCP Elite 数据目录与历史可视化。可参考其把人物、机构、岗位和任职轨迹分别编码的方法，也可用来形成比较不同届次干部背景的研究问题。

目录与可视化有各自的历史覆盖范围，不能用来替代当前的官方任免核对。目录注明数据使用需要作者或权利人许可；这里保留研究入口，未导入受限数据。

guides.title: 资料怎么核实与更新
guides.body:
一条职务、一条学历，分别保留依据。原文支持、无日期目录、历史资料、未核实和来源冲突各自标明。
自动检查列出已记录的身份待核候选，并检查日期矛盾和证据缺口；事实仍须对照原文。旧目录不能压过新任免，同一通稿的转载也不算多份独立证明。
来源网页、事件日期、核对日期分开保存。历史背景允许逐项补充；不知道的继续空着。新的采集入口先评估，再生成候选更新，不自动改现任。

guides.title: 任职变动、处分与司法进展
guides.body:
先分清任职、纪律、身份和司法四条线。同一天的通报可能涉及多条线，每个动作分别记，不把一个“落马”标签当作完整履历。

免职只说明某项职务被解除，单凭这个词不能认定是处分。政务处分中的撤职、党纪中的撤销党内职务、组织处理中的免职，是不同制度下的具体措施。换届、调任、辞职、退休也不能互相代替；只有原文明确说明原因，才标注相应的离任类型。

党纪处分有警告、严重警告、撤销党内职务、留党察看、开除党籍。政务处分有警告、记过、记大过、降级、撤职、开除。正式组织处理包括停职检查、调整职务、责令辞职、免职、降职；普通任免没有说明处理性质时，不自动放入这一类。

“双开”要展开看开除的对象。开除党籍和开除公职是一种组合，军队通报可能是开除党籍和开除军籍。本库分别显示。2025年解放军纪律条令第156条规定，开除军籍还带有取消军衔、原有职务和待遇级别自然撤销等后果；这些一般规则不替代个案公告中未披露的具体日期。

立案审查调查、移送审查起诉、检察机关提起公诉、法院判决，是不同阶段。移送不等于已经起诉，调查和处分也不等于有罪判决。只有后续原文明确给出下一阶段，才增加对应事件。

已宣布处分与仍待追认可以同时成立。党章第42条规定了有关中央和地方委员会委员处分的决定和追认程序。比如2026年9月21日张又侠、刘振立的开除党籍决定已公布，但通报仍保留中央委员会全体会议追认这一后续程序。

本库区分公告日、已知生效日和人工核对日。原文只说此前，具体日期就留空；党和国家两个军委的职务、党代表与人大代表资格也分别记录。新事件保留旧记录，只有明确的撤销或更正原文才取代原事件。

对照例：济宁市人大常委会2024年12月3日接受于永生辞去市长职务，网页12月5日刊载。本库据此写接受辞职，不把它改写成退休、处分，或对其个人原因作额外判断。

caveats: 精选公开资料库，尚非完整名册。
同地经历、同机构任期交集和公开活动分别记录，不推断私人关系。
以每条资料的核对日期为准；静态网站不会自行改变人物职务。
